notes.title: Better physics, 2 new racetracks (WIP), new song, better performance - GRIP v.1.1.6
notes.content:
Much improved vehicle physics, two new racetracks, a new song from Full Kontakt, performance optimizations and more... this is a good one.

Some videos of the Sky Track:
http://webm.land/media/GwYH.webm
http://webm.land/media/caDH.webm

Liddo5 - Islands
http://i.imgur.com/9kEpDZc.jpg


List of some [u]known issues[/u] with this patch (v.1.1.6):

[list]
[*]Alt-tabbing while the game is on the loading screen can freeze the game
[*][b]SkyTrack:[/b] Resetting on this map isn't fully supported as the code isn't ready yet.  We wanted you guys to play the track though, so we decided to put it in this patch.
[*][b]Islands Track:[/b] This map is very WIP and still needs a lot of work.  We're releasing it in this patch so we can gather valuable feedback from the community regarding (gameplay only)
[*]The menus only support mouse navigation right now.  Gamepad support will be coming as soon as possible.
[*]Vehicle physics can be screwy at times, causing your car to bounce unexpectedly, catch on geometry or spend too much time in the air.  We've been aware of these types of issue for a while and have constantly been improving physics as we go.  The Vintek Warlander is the most unstable car, physics-wise.
[*]Pickups balancing still needs work, especially the EMP
[*]Some users are reporting that pausing the game after finishing an event gets rid of mouse navigation
[*]Sometimes resetting the car on any map can transport you to another area of the map, changing your race placement
[*]Missiles like to crash into the ground sometimes upon deployment[/list]

List of [u]changes/additions[/u] in this patch:

[list]
[*]Considerably better car physics!  Rob has been busy fixing an unwanted oscillation issue as well as much improving the suspension model for all the cars.  The result is more predictable driving and less frustration
[*]TWO new racetracks!  Orbital Prime SkyTrack (by Chris) and Liddo5 Islands (by Jeffrey).  Both tracks are WIP
[*]A new ingame tune from[url=http://soundcloud.com/fullkontaktuk] Full Kontakt	[/url]
[*]Optimizations to performance.  The game should now run better overall, for all types of PC setups.  The vehicle explosion now has 15% of it's previous performance impact.
[*]Speedpad colour has been changed to green
[*]Endurance Carkour map now fixed
[*]Fixed collision issue on thin ramp asset, and added red X skin to specific instances
[*]Decreased size of HUD's mine indicator
[*]HUD speedometer now flashes red when player is targeted by a missile[/list]

Racetracks:
[b]FIC Outpost[/b]
[list]
[*]Added snowmen and lights to the starting gate :)
[*]Added wallride to upper route in valley area
[*]Removed 2nd big jump, improved 1st big one
[*]Tilted forcefield barriers so players are less likely to ride them
[*]Gave rocks proper collision, removed unnecessary meshes[/list]
[b]Alhatra[/b]
[list]
[*]Huge amount of optimizations in terms of lighting and mesh LODing
[*]Smoothed terrain in areas[/list]
[b]Transport[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved some areas visually.  Added animation to some structures as a test
[*]Still need to rework the tunnel changes in last version to increase difficult and interest[/list]
[b]Yuri Industrial[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked left route on the main hill to be quicker and more useful
[*]Added more signage[/list]

If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]
 
Or you can visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900]Steam Page[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: New car incoming, and what to expect for next patch
notes.content:
Check this out:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iDQCyqg.jpg[/img]


That is the Vintek tank class vehicle.  [u][b]Got a name for it[/b][/u]?  Remember that the mid-class is called the "Warlander"

Regarding other development, it's been rather slim on the coding side of things as my main dev partner Rob has involuntarily been unable to work much the past month.  We're still making progress though.

I've been working some more on the current levels to improve them, as well as our other designer, Jeffrey.  That, and getting the next few levels in the pipeline more fleshed out.  Two of those levels are set on Liddo5 and the other on Norvos.

[u][b]Question[/b][/u]:  Would you guys rather have a development focus on only new levels right now, or would you be happy with me dedicating some time to a nighttime version of one of the current maps, to be released next update?

Speaking of the next update, expect some big improvements to performance on Alhatra, as well as overall, due to some additional optimization of lighting and particle effects.

Also included in the patch will be a NEW music track from Full Kontakt, various level improvements and other tweaks.  I can't give you a release date for the patch, but we will 100% have one before Christmas, and it will have some Christmas-y stuff in it ;)

Lastly, just a note that if you're looking for more in-depth conversation, our forum is quite active, and I've posted a few new polls on there to gather opinions on various subjects.  We'd love to have you over there!

https://cagedelement.com/forum/

-Chris

notes.title: GRIP Update v.1.1.5 is now on Steam!
notes.content:
This update consists of mainly track changes, as we're trying to make what we've got thus far, look and flow better.  This will help make the cars more predictable and reduce frustrations, as will our upcoming improvements to physics/handling.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/396900][img]https://www.cagedelement.com/grip/temp/Patch115.jpg[/img][/url]

NOTE: For those of you who are using the Private branch on Steam, that version still has multiplayer functionality, but will not have the latest track updates.  We are still working on getting a multiplayer version ready with a bunch of fixes

Here is a list of some known issues with this patch (v.1.1.5):
[list]
[*]The menus only support mouse navigation right now.  Gamepad support will be coming as soon as possible.
[*]Vehicle physics can be screwy at times, causing your car to bounce unexpectedly, catch on geometry or spend too much time in the air.  We've been aware of these types of issue for a while and have constantly been improving physics as we go.  We won't stop until GRIP's cars are a dream to drive (NOTE: The Vintek Warlander is by far the least stable car in terms of physics issues)
[*]Some users with older PCs may experience lower performance with the last few patches.  This is due to us updating our custom Unreal Engine version to 4.12, and not having the time to fully optimize yet.
[*]For very few users the game may [b]freeze[/b] periodically[b] while playing[/b]. This is an issue associated with UE4, of which Epic are aware. If you experience this, some possible workarounds can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396750/discussions/1/343786714894834690/?ctp=2]HERE[/url] or [url=http://cagedelement.comgriptemp/https://www.epicgames.com/paragon/forums/showthread.php?7771-Solution-for-5-sec-freeze-randomly#post_0]HERE[/url]
[*]Pickups balancing still needs work
[*]The Vintek Warlander's rim customization currently has Cygon rims, when it shouldn't
[*]Some users are reporting that pausing the game after finishing an event gets rid of mouse navigation
[*]Some Vintek sound effects may be louder than other sounds
[*][b]Transport:[/b] There are a few areas of the map where you can reset outside of the race tunnel and fall into the void.[/list]

A list of changes to the racetracks in this patch:

[b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]
[list]
[*]Smoothed a lot of terrain, lowered terrain in area prior to radio tower so that there is no longer a blind hump
[*]Improved collision in various parts of the map, most notably the large building near the starting gate
[*]Improved various areas with new or updated structures and rock formations, as well as included a new ramp spline that allows players to perform a barrel roll/loop-di-loop
[*]Note: Alhatra's performance has been getting worse, although we've been performing many optimizations.  We're looking into this issue[/list]

[b]Transport[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely rebuilt an area of the track that proved frustrating for players.  The corner directly after the exit of the first tunnel in forwards has now been replaced with a route that takes you higher up the hill (NOTE: this is still WIP, we will be changing the turn in the tunnel to help produce more corkscrew driving)
[*]Improved collision in various parts of the map, and updated the collision mesh for the bridge spline
[*]Removed troublesome obstacles in the tunnels and added more flowing ramp splines that are either there to be dodged or to encourage rolling cars onto their other side
[*]Added various structures[/list]

[b]Yuri Industrial[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved first corner on the left route in reverse mode
[*]Added flag assets as a test to see how they function/look
[*]Added some ramp assets[/list]

[b]FIC Outpost[/b]
[list]
[*]Smoothed various parts of the terrain, including the entrance into the cave tunnel
[*]Improved collision in many areas, as well as updated rock assets with proper collision
[*]Added some habitat structures (blue buildings)
[*]Optimized level overall[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimized forcefield asset so it's less demanding on performance
[*]Improved various AI splines and added avoidance volumes to make AI better at navigating tracks[/list]


If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]
 
Or you can visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900]Steam Page[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

[*]Some users with older PCs may experience lower performance with the last few patches.  This is due to us updating our custom Unreal Engine version to 4.12, and not having the time to fully optimize yet.  We'll be looking at this over the next month
[*]For very few users the game may [b]freeze[/b] periodically[b] while playing[/b]. This is an issue associated with UE4, of which Epic are aware. If you experience this, some possible workarounds can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396750/discussions/1/343786714894834690/?ctp=2]HERE[/url] or [url=http://cagedelement.comgriptemp/https://www.epicgames.com/paragon/forums/showthread.php?7771-Solution-for-5-sec-freeze-randomly#post_0]HERE[/url]
[*]Pickups balancing still needs work, as the EMP gets spammed more than we'd like it to.
[*]Driving through a pumpkin pickup may cause a slight delay.  We're looking into this
[*]The Vintek Warlander's rim customization is broken.  It actually doesn't have any custom rims yet, so the rims screen will be unavailable next patch
[*]The Vintek shield may have an issue where it gets disabled unexpectedly
[*]Some users are reporting that pausing the game after finishing an event gets rid of mouse navigation
[*]Some Vintek sound effects may be louder than other sounds.  This will be fixed next patch
[*]Missile navigation may not work properly on occasion.  we're looking into this
[*][b]Transport:[/b] There are a few areas of the map where you can reset outside of the race tunnel and fall into the void.
[*][b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]: The car likes to bounce around more on this map than any other, unfortunately. Also, the map still needs some flow work, including a rebuild of the upper path to the left past the bridge in the forwards direction[/list]

[b]A list of added stuff in this patch:[/b]
[list]
[*]A NEW vehicle!  The Vintek Warlander.  This is a vintage type vehicle from a new manufacturer.  It's also the first mid-class car we've put in the game, having performance and weight characteristics somewhere in between the Dreadnaught and the Dominator
[*]A spooky menu skin complete with totally scary pumpkins
[*]A modified version of Alhatra Wastes that has vibrant Halloween themes throughout.  Look out for the bats!
[*]New shield designs for the Cygon and Vintek manufacturers.  This helps give each car brand their own identity
[*]4 new carkour maps of varying difficulty
[*]New "Slicks" tires available for any vehicle type
[*]Windowed and Windowed Full Screen options are now available in the the settings menu (be sure to restart the game)
[*]Adjusted steering sensitivity to allow for less twitchy settings
[*]Fixed issue with vehicle rims turning red when the game uses their LODs
[*]Various other bug fixes[/list]

notes.title: GRIP Multplayer testing now available on the private Steam branch!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.cagedelement.com/grip/pics/GRIP_Logo2.png[/img]
-
GRIP [b]MULTIPLAYER [/b]testing is now available in the [b]Private[/b] branch on Steam!!
-

We're excited to have our dedicated community finally be able to play the game online with friends and strangers alike. If you're able to jump on and test the game this week, that would really [b]help us[/b], as we're trying to get a public version out ASAP!

[b]This testing phase is exclusive to people who backed our website funding campaign. [/b]

(If you haven't accessed the private branch for GRIP on Steam yet, the code is [b]"[/b]SnarSn4r5n4r". Enter it, then opt into the the private beta)  This is basically a gift to our active Steam members who have been dedicated to the game but weren't able to back our website campaign.  Thanks for being great fans and constantly supporting us!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/396900][img]http://www.cagedelement.com/grip/pics/PrivateMP.jpg[/img][/url]

The multiplayer menu has options for Find a Game, Join a Game, Create a Game and local Splitscreen. Finding a game allows you to input a preferred configuration to search for, with the game finding an event that most suits your search criteria. Joining a game requires you to know the game's specific name, which is the best way to play with friends.There are currently some issues with the game, but that's to be expected with the first iteration of multiplayer functionality.

Here is a list of known issues or features we need to add
Multiplayer:

[list][*]*NEW* [b]Fatal errors[/b]:  Sometimes when trying to join a game, you may get a fatal error.  This had not popped up in internal testing, so apologies if it happens to you.  Be sure to end the process "Music Player" in task manager if the game does crash, or you won't be able to run it again.
[b]Arena Mode: [/b]There is an issue where the player's vehicle may act very strangely, floating and sliding around. This occurs after getting destroyed, but may not be consistent or persistent, or might not happen at all.[*]Although [b]bots[/b] can be enabled in multiplayer games, they may cause performance issues for players with older hardware. If you are running the game on medium or low, we suggest disabling bots when creating an online game. Be advised though, that some games you find online will have bots enabled.[*]Sometimes [b]map voting[/b] is a bit bugged, in that the wrong selections will show for the game mode. This is usually fixed by changing the game mode a few times[*]Sometimes the info feed will say a [b]player has joined[/b] the game when they're already connected[*]When [b]spectating[/b] cars, the player name is not shown.. This will be added soon.[*]Cars can [b]intersect[/b] with each other if some users have a bad net connection[*]Lobby [b]chat[/b] and ingame quickchat need an[b] anti-spam[/b] filter[*]When [b]spectating[/b] in multiplayer, there is a bug where you may not hear vehicle engine sounds.[*]When an event is starting, the [b]syncing[/b] time may take longer if someone with a lower-end PC is joining[*][b]Pickup balancing[/b] can be a bit distorted in multiplayer, with players being able to grab the same thing multiple times in a row. We are looking into this[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*]New Liddo5 map (Islands)!  We totally left it in there by accident.. but hey, now we can get more feedback.  It's in extremely early stages and there's not even enough spawns for 10 cars, but it's a good indication of how cool it'll be :)  Enjoy it while it's still available!
[*][b]Transport:[/b] There are a few areas of the map where you can reset outside of the race tunnel and fall into the void. These will be fixed soon[*][b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]: The car likes to bounce around more on this map than any other, unfortunately. Also, the map still needs some flow work, including a rebuild of the upper path to the left past the bridge in the forwards direction[/list]

General:
[list][*]The [b]menu[/b] only has[b] mouse support[/b] right now.We will be adding gamepad support as soon as we can[*]You might lose your previous [b]vehicle customization[/b] after updating GRIP on Steam. Sorry! We'll have car customization saving in the game hopefully soon.[*]You may experience some [b]bouncier or floatier vehicle physics[/b] in this build. This is due to us updating our custom Unreal build to 4.12. We'll be looking into fixing these issues inNovember[*]The game can sometimes [b]freeze[/b] if player is alt-tabbing during the loading screen. Try not to alt-tab when it's loading ;)[*]A small amount of users with [b]older GPUs[/b] may experience performance decreases with this patch. We've just updated our custom version of Unreal Engine to 4.12 and are still optimizing[*]For very few users the game may [b]freeze[/b] periodically[b] while playing[/b]. This is an issue associated with UE4, of which Epic are aware. If you experience this, some possible workarounds can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396750/discussions/1/343786714894834690/?ctp=2]HERE[/url] or [url=http://cagedelement.comgriptemp/https://www.epicgames.com/paragon/forums/showthread.php?7771-Solution-for-5-sec-freeze-randomly#post_0]HERE[/url][/list]
We're doing our best to fix as many of these issues as possible for the next patch, which will hopefully be a public release of multiplayer!

If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]
 
Or you can visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900]Steam Page[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: GRIP Update v.1.1.0 is now available!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release [b]v.1.1.0[/b] is now on Steam!
-

NOTE:  We debated releasing [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b] with this patch, but stability issues convinced us otherwise.  We're working hard to get multiplayer integrated ASAP.  Game dev will be game dev :/ 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N5drBJv.jpg[/img]

Even without multiplayer, this is our biggest patch yet, with a ton of new content including a brand new MENU, a new VEHICLE, better CAR PHYSICS the new CARKOUR game mode, a new TRACK, and much more.  Tons of things to keep you busy!

[b]NOTE:[/b]  GAMEPAD NAVIGATION IS NOT CURRENTLY WORKING IN THE MENU. We'll do our best to get it in with the Multiplayer patch

Other known issues with v.1.1.0:

[list]
[*]Your input and car customization settings may not save the first time running the game.  Subsequent runs of the game seem to save them properly.
[*]Input assignment can be buggy.  This will be fixed for next patch
[*]Car colour customization in the garage can be strange when trying to achieve pure white.  Try moving the hue bar to yellow if the car isn't bright enough.
[*]Pickups balancing has a bug where you may get the same pickup more often than you should.  We are looking into it.
[*]Music ingame can stop playing.  If this happens, exit the event and change the music volume value to try and reset it.
[*]You may very rarely get a crash.  If the game does crash, be sure to go into task manager and kill the process "Music Player" or Steam will still think the game is running
[*]21:9 and other wide aspect ratios have a bug where the HUD isn't centering properly.  We are working on it.
[*]Car rims turn red once the first LOD distance is hit.  We'll fix this for next patch
[*]In Carkour, if you make it to the end of the course but fail to grab the collectible, the end camera may get stuck even after reset.  If this happens, you'll need to back to the menu and reload the map.  This will be fixed for next patch
[*]Sometimes the car exhaust effects fail to appear until the accelerator is let go an engaged again
[*]Slow motion has been removed from the game for now, but the input value still exists in the settings[/list]

Here is the FULL CHANGELIST for patch 1.1.0:

Gameplay:
[list]
[*]A new [b]Cygon Cyclone[/b] car is now playable, with it's own sounds and visual effects.  This vehicle is of the Speedster class, which is the same class as the Dominator.  A middle class car is coming very soon, and we think you'll love it  (Note: a new shield design specific to the Cygon manufacturer will be coming later as well)
[*]The [b]vehicle physics[/b] now have code that prevents the cars from launching into the air so much.  You'll see a drastic improvement in how the car interacts with terrain and rocks.  The cars also feel heavier upon landing
[*]New [b]Carkour[/b] game mode:  This is our homage to [i]Scramble[/i] mode from Rollcage Stage 2.  This mode has you navigating an obstacle course to grab collectibles in the fastest time possible.
[*]New [b]Ultimate Race[/b] game mode:  Instead of ranking the racers on just their position, Ultimate mode takes into account things like weapons use, average speed, and lap times to tally up a points total for each player.  The player with the most points by the end of the race, wins.
[*][b]Arena mode[/b] is now improved, with traditional deathmatch gameplay and more modes coming later.
[*]Catch-up implementation is improved, with less obvious change in vehicle speeds.  This helps keep the race pack together[/list]
Levels:
[list]
[*][b]New Racetrack[/b] set on Liddo5 called [b]Speedbowl[/b]!  This track is our homage to a certain track from the original Rollcage ;)   It's quite a simple map, but also a LOT of fun
[*][b]Liddo 5 - Biodome:[/b] Overall layout and visual quality is much better, with a bunch of different ways to traverse the level.  AI now use the ceiling of the dome as well.  This map is a good showcase for fun Arena mode gameplay, and more arenas will be coming within the next few months
[*][b]Norvos - FIC Outpost[/b]: Improved flow, smoothed terrain, added more pickups, improved overall visual quality and layout.  Fixed a few collision issues, plus an issue where race checkpoints weren't working properly (The map is still very WIP)
[*][b]Jahtra - Alhatra Wastes:[/b] Improved flow and greatly improved visual quality, with new structures throughout the map.  Also improved AI pathing and performance.  This map is still WIP, as some areas need re-doing and the reverse version's routes are not finished
[*][b]Liddo 5 - Transport[/b]:  Improved visual quality and fixed some collision issues
[*][b]Jahtra - Yuri Industrial[/b]:  Improved flow, AI pathing and tunnel entrance collision to be less frustrating
[*][b]Festive[/b]:  Removed this map for now, as it will be exclusive to the holiday season.[/list]
UI:
[list]
[*]We have a [b]brand new Menu[/b], which is at least 100x better than the previous one. We're pretty proud of it :D  This new menu also includes a [b]GARAGE [/b] where you can [b]customize your vehicles[/b] with different paint jobs, tires and rims.  This is just the beginning of our car customization options.
[*]The settings menu has a plethora of options for your tweaking pleasure, including FOV adjustment, HUD opacity, force feedback on/off, HUD damage effects on/off, FPS limiter and plenty of screen options
[*]There is now a custom music [b]jukebox [/b]in the audio options.  Just drag your music into the jukebox folder and enable it in the menu to hear your tunes ingame!
[*]The pause menu now has all the settings available from the main menu for easy adjustment
[*]The HUD is improved in that it's easier to read and has more information.  We've also added an indicator for mines on the track, as well as changed how missile targeting works, so let us know what you think of them
[*][b]Input customization[/b] is now available in the settings menu.  You're now able to set up your controls however you like! (NOTE: Some issues may occur with remapping controls.  We're still working on them)[/list]
Pickups:
[list]
[*]Missile navigation improved, plus fixed issues with specific parts of levels causing an assassin collision
[*]Raptor MG now targets mines effectively, destroying them with one bullet
[*]Pickup balancing is now better (though there are a couple bugs that need to be addressed)[/list]
Visual:
[list]
[*]Chase camera improvements:  You can now orbit the camera around the car, crashing is less disorienting, overall direction of camera is more intuitive
[*]Cinematic cameras in demo mode/end of race improved, as well as depth of field effect[/list]
Audio:
[list]
[*]Some tweaked and added sounds
[*][i]Just a reminder that many sounds in the game (including car engines) are first versions and are subject to change/improve[/i][/list]
Optimization/fixes:
[list]
[*]Particle effects have been optimized and players should see an overall performance increase
[*]Added LOD models for various level meshes, optimized some particle effects[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Coming in the next update:
[list]
[*]MULTIPLAYER[/list]
Coming in the next few updates:
[list]
[*]Player stats
[*]Two new cars
[*]A new racetrack
[*]A new arena
[*]More Carkour maps
[*]An additional weapon[/list]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, we'd love to hear your feedback.  If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]

notes.title: GRIP Update v.1.1.0 is now available!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release [b]v.1.1.0[/b] is now on Steam!
-

NOTE:  We debated releasing [b]MULTIPLAYER[/b] with this patch, but stability issues convinced us otherwise.  We're working hard to get multiplayer integrated ASAP.  Game dev will be game dev :/ 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N5drBJv.jpg[/img]

Even without multiplayer, this is our biggest patch yet, with a ton of new content including a brand new MENU, a new VEHICLE, better CAR PHYSICS the new CARKOUR game mode, a new TRACK, and much more.  Tons of things to keep you busy!

[b]NOTE:[/b]  GAMEPAD NAVIGATION IS NOT CURRENTLY WORKING IN THE MENU. We'll do our best to get it in with the Multiplayer patch

Other known issues with v.1.1.0:

[list]
[*]Your input and car customization settings may not save the first time running the game.  Subsequent runs of the game seem to save them properly.
[*]Input assignment can be buggy.  This will be fixed for next patch
[*]Car colour customization in the garage can be strange when trying to achieve pure white.  Try moving the hue bar to yellow if the car isn't bright enough.
[*]Pickups balancing has a bug where you may get the same pickup more often than you should.  We are looking into it.
[*]Music ingame can stop playing.  If this happens, exit the event and change the music volume value to try and reset it.
[*]You may very rarely get a crash.  If the game does crash, be sure to go into task manager and kill the process "Music Player" or Steam will still think the game is running
[*]21:9 and other wide aspect ratios have a bug where the HUD isn't centering properly.  We are working on it.
[*]Car rims turn red once the first LOD distance is hit.  We'll fix this for next patch
[*]In Carkour, if you make it to the end of the course but fail to grab the collectible, the end camera may get stuck even after reset.  If this happens, you'll need to back to the menu and reload the map.  This will be fixed for next patch
[*]Sometimes the car exhaust effects fail to appear until the accelerator is let go an engaged again
[*]Slow motion has been removed from the game for now, but the input value still exists in the settings[/list]

Here is the FULL CHANGELIST for patch 1.1.0:

Gameplay:
[list]
[*]A new [b]Cygon Cyclone[/b] car is now playable, with it's own sounds and visual effects.  This vehicle is of the Speedster class, which is the same class as the Dominator.  A middle class car is coming very soon, and we think you'll love it  (Note: a new shield design specific to the Cygon manufacturer will be coming later as well)
[*]The [b]vehicle physics[/b] now have code that prevents the cars from launching into the air so much.  You'll see a drastic improvement in how the car interacts with terrain and rocks.  The cars also feel heavier upon landing
[*]New [b]Carkour[/b] game mode:  This is our homage to [i]Scramble[/i] mode from Rollcage Stage 2.  This mode has you navigating an obstacle course to grab collectibles in the fastest time possible.
[*]New [b]Ultimate Race[/b] game mode:  Instead of ranking the racers on just their position, Ultimate mode takes into account things like weapons use, average speed, and lap times to tally up a points total for each player.  The player with the most points by the end of the race, wins.
[*][b]Arena mode[/b] is now improved, with traditional deathmatch gameplay and more modes coming later.
[*]Catch-up implementation is improved, with less obvious change in vehicle speeds.  This helps keep the race pack together[/list]
Levels:
[list]
[*][b]New Racetrack[/b] set on Liddo5 called [b]Speedbowl[/b]!  This track is our homage to a certain track from the original Rollcage ;)   It's quite a simple map, but also a LOT of fun
[*][b]Liddo 5 - Biodome:[/b] Overall layout and visual quality is much better, with a bunch of different ways to traverse the level.  AI now use the ceiling of the dome as well.  This map is a good showcase for fun Arena mode gameplay, and more arenas will be coming within the next few months
[*][b]Norvos - FIC Outpost[/b]: Improved flow, smoothed terrain, added more pickups, improved overall visual quality and layout.  Fixed a few collision issues, plus an issue where race checkpoints weren't working properly (The map is still very WIP)
[*][b]Jahtra - Alhatra Wastes:[/b] Improved flow and greatly improved visual quality, with new structures throughout the map.  Also improved AI pathing and performance.  This map is still WIP, as some areas need re-doing and the reverse version's routes are not finished
[*][b]Liddo 5 - Transport[/b]:  Improved visual quality and fixed some collision issues
[*][b]Jahtra - Yuri Industrial[/b]:  Improved flow, AI pathing and tunnel entrance collision to be less frustrating
[*][b]Festive[/b]:  Removed this map for now, as it will be exclusive to the holiday season.[/list]
UI:
[list]
[*]We have a [b]brand new Menu[/b], which is at least 100x better than the previous one. We're pretty proud of it :D  This new menu also includes a [b]GARAGE [/b] where you can [b]customize your vehicles[/b] with different paint jobs, tires and rims.  This is just the beginning of our car customization options.
[*]The settings menu has a plethora of options for your tweaking pleasure, including FOV adjustment, HUD opacity, force feedback on/off, HUD damage effects on/off, FPS limiter and plenty of screen options
[*]There is now a custom music [b]jukebox [/b]in the audio options.  Just drag your music into the jukebox folder and enable it in the menu to hear your tunes ingame!
[*]The pause menu now has all the settings available from the main menu for easy adjustment
[*]The HUD is improved in that it's easier to read and has more information.  We've also added an indicator for mines on the track, as well as changed how missile targeting works, so let us know what you think of them
[*][b]Input customization[/b] is now available in the settings menu.  You're now able to set up your controls however you like! (NOTE: Some issues may occur with remapping controls.  We're still working on them)[/list]
Pickups:
[list]
[*]Missile navigation improved, plus fixed issues with specific parts of levels causing an assassin collision
[*]Raptor MG now targets mines effectively, destroying them with one bullet
[*]Pickup balancing is now better (though there are a couple bugs that need to be addressed)[/list]
Visual:
[list]
[*]Chase camera improvements:  You can now orbit the camera around the car, crashing is less disorienting, overall direction of camera is more intuitive
[*]Cinematic cameras in demo mode/end of race improved, as well as depth of field effect[/list]
Audio:
[list]
[*]Some tweaked and added sounds
[*][i]Just a reminder that many sounds in the game (including car engines) are first versions and are subject to change/improve[/i][/list]
Optimization/fixes:
[list]
[*]Particle effects have been optimized and players should see an overall performance increase
[*]Added LOD models for various level meshes, optimized some particle effects[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Coming in the next update:
[list]
[*]MULTIPLAYER[/list]
Coming in the next few updates:
[list]
[*]Player stats
[*]Two new cars
[*]A new racetrack
[*]A new arena
[*]More Carkour maps
[*]An additional weapon[/list]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, we'd love to hear your feedback.  If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]

Or visit the GRIP discussions page on Steam: http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900/discussions/

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: GRIP Multiplayer update delayed a week or two, but there's good news!
notes.content:
We need some more time to implement multiplayer properly, so we need to push the release of the next update back a little bit.  Sorry for the delay guys, but it's necessary to create a better game for you to play.

Speaking of which, this extra time gives the non-programmers the opportunity to create some maps for our "new" game mode: Carkour (it's actually a renaming of "Playground")

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Rua4Y9v.jpg[/img]

You'll no doubt notice some similarities to a specific mode from Rollcage Stage 2 ;)

The visuals for these maps are by no means final, but they will certainly have a different look, compared to the levels in GRIP's other modes

Can't wait to see everyone try these Carkour maps out :)

notes.title: GRIP Update 1.0.11.1 is now available!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release [b]v.1.0.11.1[/b] is now live!
-

In this patch there are big improvements to vehicle stability, AI competitiveness, race cameras and low-end PC performance.  Plus, a new track on the planet Norvos!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/396900][img]http://www.cagedelement.com/grip/temp/Patch1011.jpg[/img][/url]

Here is the full changelist for patch 1.0.11.1:

Gameplay:
[list][*]Far more [b]stability[/b] when driving.  The car doesn't react so harshly to collisions (vehicle physics and handling are still a WIP).   The issue with the car not gaining traction on curves or slopes (mostly in tunnels) is now fixed as well.
[*][b] Large improvements to AI:[/b]  AI are now more competitive, navigating tracks more easily and avoiding obstacles/collisions.  They also recover quicker from crashes
[*][b]Race cameras[/b] have been improved, and various movement has been added to help with immersion and sense of speed.  Recovery is also more intuitive.[/list]
Levels:
[list]
[*][b]New Racetrack[/b] set on the planet Norvos!
[*][b]Transport:[/b] Added more detailed structures (still WIP), improved lighting overall
[*][b]Yuri Industrial[/b]: Added some meshes, improved lighting overall
[*][b]Basin/Biodome/Festive:[/b] Improved lighting[/list]
Visual:
[list][*][b]Cinematic/recap cameras[/b] are improved, with more dynamic angles and sweeping shots, as well as controlled zoom
[*]Greatly improved the small tunnel asset in Jahtra tracks
[*]Cars now have visibly sandy/dirty/snowy tires when on terrain
[*]Updated [b]starting gate[/b] to be more detailed[/list]
Pickups:
[list]
[*][b]Missile[/b] navigation has been improved, with them more aptly avoiding environmental hazards[/list]
Audio:
[list][*][b]New music track![/b] "Pragmatic - Going Down"[/list]
Optimization/fixes:
[list]
[*]Optimized vehicle meshes, all particle effects and many level assets.  Performance on lower spec machines should be much better now
[*]The [b]incoming missile indicator[/b] is now a flashing icon above the speedo, rather than the borders of the screen turning red
[*]Fixed [b]shield[/b] staying in world when car is destroyed.  Also, two shields now cannot be picked up at the same time.[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Coming in the next few months:
[list]
[*]Pick-up balancing
[*]Calming vehicle vs environment collisions
[*]A new vehicle from the "Cygon" manufacturer
[*]Completely redesigned menu with much better setup and functionality
[*]Basic vehicle customization
[*]An additional weapon
[*]Additional racetracks on Liddo5 and Jahtra
[*]Multiplayer![/list]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, we'd love to hear your feedback.  If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]

Or visit the GRIP discussions page on Steam: http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900/discussions/

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: GRIP
notes.content:
Premature Evaluation is a weekly dive into the world of early access games, which Brendan has now permanently seized from the Rob Zacny in a bloodless coup. Thanks Rob! This week, he goes speeding through the future world of combat racer GRIP, frequently upside down.

GRIP is the spiritual successor to Rollcage – but also to those remote-controlled cars that were massive in the nineties, and which could not climb the ceiling no matter how hard you believed. If you haven’t heard of Rollcage, I wouldn’t be surprised. It is the forgotten son of the futuristic racer era of the late 90s and early 00s, overshadowed by its older brother, Wipeout. And who could be surprised? Wipeout had the Chemical Brothers, it had techno and ecstasy, it had that one scene in Hackers. What did Rollcage have? A set of toys that routinely malfunctioned after three weeks.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: GRIP Update 1.0.10.1 is now available!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release [b]v.1.0.10.1[/b] is now live!
-
The biggest changes in this patch revolve around physics interactions.  The problems with bouncing violently and catching on the environment has been greatly reduced, and car vs car collision has been improved.  That said, physics and collision are, as always, an ongoing work in progress, so the car vs environment collisions, weight of the car and overall driving will improve as we continue development.

NOTE:  Unfortunately the Norvos track was not up to our standards for this patch, but we will have it in the game as soon as we can.

Gameplay:
[list][*][b]Better physics:[/b] Greatly reduced are the instances where the car will catch on geometry in tunnels, bounce on landing or fall through the world.  Overall the driving is smoother and less frustrating (vehicle physics and handling are still a WIP)
[*][b]AI improvements:[/b]  AI now try their best to avoid other cars and mines.  Plus they drive better on all maps (NOTE: Wild mode is experimental and we are not optimizing AI pathing for this mode)
[*][b]Speedpads[/b] are now in the levels.  This is their first implementation, and it's meant to be more of a test than anything.  Give them a try!
[*][b]Vehicle camera[/b] now subtly points down the direction of the track if player is off course (this is a WIP and just the beginning of camera improvements)[/list]

Pickups:
[list]
[*][b]New Pickup! (EMP):[/b] A blast that will disable other car's engines and pickups temporarily.  How effective it is depends on the car's position in the race and distance from the blast (this is the first implementation of the EMP and so it's not final.  It's look and functionality will change over time)
[*][b]Mines[/b] now plant if the user is relatively close to the ground.  Also fixed them getting planted at strange angles
[*][b]Shield[/b] now emits effect and sound when hit by machine gun
[*][b]Raptor[/b] machine gun has an improved sound effect, plus knocks cars around a bit less, as it was overpowered[/list]

Levels:
[list]
[*][b]Transport:[/b] Changed overall atmosphere/lighting, added some more assets and improved flow.
[*][b]Alhatra Wastes:[/b]  Smoothed some terrain, reworked one of the routes after the bridge, added various new effects to the environment. 
[*][b]Yuri Industrial[/b]: Added better collision for tunnel entrances, raised forcefield in some spots, removed destructible pillars for now, as they were causing issues[/list]

Visual:
[list][*][b]Better explosions:[/b] They are now punchier and brighter
[*]Improved [b]Dreadnaught[/b] overall textures and greatly improved exhaust effects.  Also improved exhaust for Dominator
[*][b]Track lighting and effects[/b] have been improved on all three.
[*][b]Depth of field[/b] effect added to end-of-race cinematic cameras[/list]

Optimization/fixes:
[list]
[*]The [b]HUD[/b] now creates less of a performance hit
[*]Car collision with [b]Destructibles and physics objects[/b] has greatly improved.  No more getting a barrel caught under your tire
[*][b]Various materials[/b] have been optimized
[*][b]Vehicles[/b] are now set up for future customization options.  This took quite a bit of time, but we are now ready for the future ;)
[*]Improvements to [b]missile navigation[/b] overall[/list]

[list]
[*]New Norvos track
[*]New vehicle from a new manufacturer
[*]Completely redesigned menu with better setup and functionality
[*]Basic vehicle customization
[*]An additional weapon
[*]Multiplayer![/list]

notes.title: GRIP Update 1.0.9 is now available!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release [b]v.1.0.9 [/b]is now live!
-

The biggest change is a better friction model for the vehicles which allows for some natural drift.  This brings us one step closer to the type of driving we want people to experience with our game!  Also included in this patch is the new Elimination mode (like Knockout), as well as a ghost car of your best lap in time trial (appears after the first lap) and various tweaks to tracks.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/396900][img]http://www.cagedelement.com/grip/temp/Patch109.jpg[/img][/url]

Here is the full changelist for patch 1.0.9:

Gameplay:
[list][*][b]Drifting![/b] The cars now have an improved friction model that allows for natural drift.[*][b]Elimination Mode![/b] There is a timer that counts down and every time it reaches zero, the racer in last explodes.  Very intense mode![*][b]Ghost car[/b] now visible in Time Trial after your first lap (will mimic your best lap, every lap)[*][b]Airborne thrust: [/b]Vehicles can now accelerate in mid air due to the rear jet thrust.  Be careful![*][b]AI[/b] now try to avoid mines placed on the track[*]Better [b]missile[/b] navigation (WIP)[*]Improved [b]rumble pad[/b] functionality for gamepad [*]Fixed mines not planting properly[*]Fixed vehicle getting stuck sideways on race barrier (now gets pushed off)[*][b]Assassin missile[/b] can no longer be spammed by AI[/list]

Levels:[list][*]Added new race boundaries to Industrial, Alhatra and Transport.  This prevents the cars from flying out of the level[*][b]Transport:[/b] Improved flow, eliminated or alleviated frustration with some problematic objects (many obstacles still need fixing)[*][b]Industrial[/b]: Improved flow and tweaked problematic areas[*][b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]: Reworked various areas, smoothed terrain and improved overall flow[/list]

Visual:[list][*][b]Cinematic camera[/b] has improved, with better views and implementation[*][b]4:3 Screen resolution[/b] now supported[*][b]21:9 Screen resolution[/b] now supported (may still have issues with the HUD)[*][b]HUD:[/b] Added direction indicator on HUD in the center (activates when car is not facing correct direction of the track)[/list]

If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: GRIP update 1.0.8 is now live!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release [b]v.1.0.8 [/b]is now live!
-

Another big patch that has plenty of improvements and additions!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/396900][img]http://www.cagedelement.com/grip/temp/Patch108.jpg[/img][/url]

The biggest changes include a new car, large improvements to the vehicle driving model, reverse and mirror mode for the tracks, overall better ingame audio, as well as gamepad navigation working properly in the menus.

Here is the full changelist for patch 1.0.8:

Gameplay:
[list][*][b]New car![/b] The tank class vehicle is now available to drive.It is a bit slower off the line, but has a higher top speed and less twitchy handling compared to the first vehicle[*][b]Improved drivability: [/b] The vehicles now behave more predictably when colliding with walls or other cars, and are more enjoyable to drive in general (car physics and handling are WIP)[*][b]New Game Modes![/b] In the race setup options, you are now able to enable reverse and/or mirror mode.The existing tracks feel and look very different with these enabled, so give it a try![*][b]Destructible vehicles: [/b]In the race setup menu, you can now enable vehicles to be destroyed, making the race not only about winning, but also about staying alive[*][b]AI[/b] are now more aggressive in passing opponents (car vs car collisions are still WIP)[*]Better [b]missile[/b] navigation (WIP)[*]Fixed a bunch of issues with [b]split screen[/b] functionality[/list]
Levels:[list][*][b]Transport:[/b] Improved overall visual quality, changed layout for some sections, added race barriers and blocking volumes (this level is still a WIP)[*][b]Industrial[/b]: Added reverse mode specific assets, improved flow and barriers[*][b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]: Added reverse mode specific assets, improved flow and barriers (still a WIP)[/list]

Visual:[list][*][b]Gamepad navigation[/b] now works properly in the menus[*][b]HUD[/b] now has glitching out effects that occur when the player is hit by missiles or is highly damaged[*][b]Menu[/b] is now easier to navigate (note: this is a temporary UI, and will be overhauled in the coming months)[*]New forcefield [b]barrier[/b] in the levels[*]New loading screen with tips[*][b]Resolution[/b] [b]options[/b] in menu are now changed via button press[*]Various improvements and optimizations[/list]
Audio:[list][*][b]Two new ingame music tracks![/b]"Crash City" by Xtigma, and "Boost Empire" by Mart-E[*][b]New sounds[/b] for vehicle engines as well as some pick-ups[*][b]Reverb[/b] can now be heard in enclosed spaces[*]Overall better sound attenuation, mastering and mixing[/list]

If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: GRIP update v.1.0.7 is now available!
notes.content:
-
GRIP Early Access Release v.1.0.7 is now live!
-

This patch is a big one, in that it allows players to tweak the vehicle's steering, as well as improves upon the catch-up feature andoverall difficulty levels. This should allow new and old players of GRIP to get the best experience out of the game. One that caters to their style and skill.

Plus, we've tweaked the vehicle's stability, making it respond better to collisions at high speeds.Overall, thedriving experience in this version has greatly improved from 1.0.6

[b]NOTE:[/b][b]  "LOW" difficulty doesn't seem to be working.  This bug will be fixed in the next patch.  For now, use medium difficulty and low engine speed if you are a novice, or just don't want to go head-splitting speeds[/b]


Here are the changes in patch 1.0.7

Levels:[list][*][b]Industrial:[/b] Added many blocking volumes, objects and smoothed terrain to create more flow and a less punishing environment[*][b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]: Fixed many visual errors, smoothed some terrain and improved overall flow[*][b]Transport[/b]: Created proper boundaries, improved flow and fixed Assassin missile navigation[*][b]Festive[/b]: Smoothed a bunch of terrain to improve traversal[/list]

Gameplay:[list][*]Vehicle now reacts more subtly to collisions at high speed and is overall more forgiving.This has much improved vehicle handling in general[*]Steering sensitivity can now be set in the control options (separate settings for keyboard and gamepad)[*]Steering speed (response) can now be set in the control options[*]Greatly improved Difficulty settings to better reflect each option. Low difficulty is now reasonable for beginners[*]Vehicle engine power can be set to medium, high and crazy[*]Time Trial is now available as a game mode (no ghost car currently)[*]Weapon allocation has been improved, based on feedback[*]Catch-up feature has been improved in relation to difficulty settings[*]General AI improvements[*]Car vs car collisions are now less catastrophic[/list]
Visual:[list][*]UI has been fixed for 16x10 resolutions[*]Intoduced some HUD effects[*]New menu font[*]New scoreboard with more data[/list]

If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]
 
Or you can visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900]Steam Page[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

Levels:[list][*][b]Industrial:[/b] Added many blocking volumes, objects and smoothed terrain to create more flow and a less punishing environment[*][b]Alhatra Wastes[/b]: Fixed many visual errors, smoothed some terrain and improved overall flow[*][b]Transport[/b]: Created proper boundaries, improved flow and fixed Assassin missile navigation[*][b]Festive[/b]: Smoothed a bunch of terrain to improve traversal[/list]

Gameplay:[list][*]Vehicle now reacts more subtly to collisions at high speed and is overall more forgiving.This has much improved vehicle handling in general[*]Steering sensitivity can now be set in the control options (separate settings for keyboard and gamepad)[*]Steering speed (response) can now be set in the control options[*]Greatly improved Difficulty settings to better reflect each option. Low difficulty is now reasonable for beginners[*]Vehicle engine power can be set to medium, high and crazy[*]Time Trial is now available as a game mode (no ghost car currently)[*]Weapon allocation has been improved, based on feedback[*]Catch-up feature has been improved in relation to difficulty settings[*]General AI improvements[*]Car vs car collisions are now less catastrophic[/list]
Visual:[list][*]UI has been fixed for 16x10 resolutions[*]Intoduced some HUD effects[*]New menu font[*]New scoreboard with more data[/list]

If you want to give feedback, or need to report any issues, please visit our forum (be sure to check the bugs and crashes lists before posting):
[url=http://www.cagedelement.com/forum]forum.cagedelement.com[/url]
 
Or you can visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396900]Steam Page[/url]

To all of our players, thank you for supporting us, and we hope you'll like what we've got coming in our next updates!

notes.title: Rollcage Reborn: Grip Enters Early Access
notes.content:
Grip [official site], a Rollcage spiritual successor made by a team including two of the original game’s developers, has entered Early Access. The initial launch only includes a single vehicle but there are seven levels and three game modes. You can also play against AI or splitscreen multiplayer. I am quite excited about this because Rollcage is one of my favourite racing games. If you’ve never played it, absorb the video below to understand why I love it so.

… [visit site to read more]
